creative.central_question: Why does AI that writes code stumble on simple sums?
creative.payoff: Models read tokens, not digits; commas (right-to-left grouping) largely improved GPT-3.5/GPT-4 arithmetic, so use commas or a calculator/code tool.
creative.visual_motif: A number cut into token tiles: left-to-right chunks that ignore place value versus comma chunks that line up.
creative.music: soft self-made pad only under hook, intro, payoff and outro; no music under the explanation; no SFX
creative.palette: chalkboard green-slate, chalk white, warm wood desk, amber and mint accents
creative.visual_world: Metaphor: a classroom where the robot student reads through glasses that cut text into wrong-size pieces. Hero objects: chalkboard and the robot student at a school desk with wooden token tiles. Camera path: frame 0 board '8302447 + 2 = ?' with a puzzled robot -> push to robot glasses -> icon B-roll text/tokens/model -> desk tiles cut left to right -> commas re-cut tiles right to left -> paper and green sum -> proof card -> letter B-roll -> callback to the same board rewritten 8,302,447 + 2 = 8,302,449 with a green tick -> wave. Opening image: puzzled robot under '8302447 + 2 = ?'. Callback: same board, commas added, green tick. Differs from the 11-22 night office desk: daylight classroom, chalk texture, wooden tiles.

scenes.narration: AI writes code... but long sums?
scenes.on_screen_text: AI can code. Why can't it add?
scenes.motion: Cold open: chalkboard already reads 8302447 + 2 = ? in chalk; robot student at its desk scratches its head, then raises a hand; slow push-in on the board
scenes.visual_description: Classroom, frame 0 shows the board '8302447 + 2 = ?' and the robot student, puzzled.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a literal classroom with a robot student, chalkboard and token tiles lets the viewer see the number being cut into chunks.

scenes.narration: They can still trip it up. Not the brain. The eyes.
scenes.motion: Camera glides from the board to the robot; thick reading glasses drop onto its face and the lenses slice a chalk line into pieces
scenes.visual_description: Robot student close-up wearing glasses that cut a chalk line into wrong-size pieces (visual metaphor).
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a literal classroom with a robot student, chalkboard and token tiles lets the viewer see the number being cut into chunks.

scenes.narration: Models don't read digits. They read tokens, small chunks of text.
scenes.motion: Motion-text B-roll: Lucide type, scissors and cpu icons pop in left to right as named, a signal dot travels the arrows and token tiles drop out
scenes.visual_description: Three icon nodes TEXT (type), TOKENS (scissors), MODEL (cpu) joined by arrows, chalkboard colours.
scenes.visual_justification: Motion-text B-roll with Lucide icons: the mechanism is drawn as icons and a travelling signal so it is readable.

scenes.narration: Picture a long number. Some models cut it left to right, up to three digits at a time.
scenes.motion: Chalk writes 8302447 on the board; tiles [830][244][7] slide onto the robot's desk one by one as the cut moves left to right; ILLUSTRATIVE stamp
scenes.visual_description: Board with the long number, three wooden token tiles on the desk, label ILLUSTRATIVE.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a literal classroom with a robot student, chalkboard and token tiles lets the viewer see the number being cut into chunks.

scenes.narration: Those chunks ignore place value. Add commas, and the cut moves right to left.
scenes.motion: Tiles shake out of line, a chalk hand drops commas into the number, tiles regroup right to left as [8][302][447] and align under ones, thousands, millions
scenes.visual_description: Same board, commas added, tiles re-cut and aligned with place-value columns; ILLUSTRATIVE stamp.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a literal classroom with a robot student, chalkboard and token tiles lets the viewer see the number being cut into chunks.

scenes.narration: Researchers tested GPT-3.5 and GPT-4. Grouping digits right to left with commas largely improved accuracy.
scenes.motion: Camera pulls back along the desk; the robot's sum lights green on the board, a paper stack lands on the desk with a source chip Singh and Strouse 2024
scenes.visual_description: Board with a sum lit green, a paper on the desk, name plates GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 on two robot desks.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a literal classroom with a robot student, chalkboard and token tiles lets the viewer see the number being cut into chunks.

scenes.narration: In bigger models, the gap shrinks.
scenes.on_screen_text: The gap shrinks in bigger models
scenes.motion: Chalk text types on; two chalk lines labelled small model and big model move closer together, no numbers shown
scenes.visual_description: Chalk-textured proof card: two lines converging, caption only (proof insert).

visual.text: The gap shrinks in bigger models

scenes.narration: Counting can suffer too, since tokenization changes how well models count.
scenes.motion: Motion-text B-roll: a word is cut into tiles by the scissors icon, an eye-off icon covers the letters inside, a counter stumbles; ILLUSTRATIVE label
scenes.visual_description: Lucide type, scissors and eye-off icons around a chalk word cut into tiles (illustrative).
scenes.visual_justification: Motion-text B-roll with Lucide icons: the mechanism is drawn as icons and a travelling signal so it is readable.

scenes.narration: So for exact math, write numbers with commas. Or ask it to use a calculator or code tool.
scenes.motion: Callback to the opening board: chalk rewrites the sum with commas, 8,302,447 + 2 = 8,302,449, and a green tick; robot straightens its glasses; calculator and code icons appear on the desk
scenes.visual_description: Opening classroom framing resolved: commas on the board, green tick, calculator and code icons beside the robot.
scenes.visual_justification: World-first: a literal classroom with a robot student, chalkboard and token tiles lets the viewer see the number being cut into chunks.

scenes.narration: For more AI concepts like this, follow.
scenes.motion: Slow pull back to the opening framing (board now shows the comma sum with a tick); robot waves; chalk underline under follow
scenes.visual_description: Opening board framing with the robot waving; end text in chalk.
